name: Across Crime
storyline:
Step into the shoes of Leah Sharp, detective at Synaptic Investigations — a covert agency that uses neural synchronization technology to project its investigators directly into reconstructed crime scenes across time and space.

Explore. Investigate. Deduce.

Each case drops you into a unique location where a murder has taken place. Search every room, interact with objects, uncover clues, and piece together the truth using your Deduction Table: a logic grid where every mark brings you closer to the killer.
summary: A deduction game where every case challenges you to uncover who committed the murder, with what, and where. Step into the shoes of Leah Sharp, a detective working for an agency that uses neural synchronization to send its investigators into reconstructed crime scenes across time and space.
